records.label: spacr.gpu_reduce#5
records.source: WHERE IT ACTUALLY HELPS. cuML implements the algorithms spaCR already runs on big tables: UMAP, t-SNE, PCA, DBSCAN and KMeans. Those are the ones offered here. Everything else spaCR does -- barcode mapping, format conversion, SQLite, report assembly, grouped statistics -- is decompression, filesystem and small-table work, and moving it to a GPU would cost transfer time and buy nothing. GPU acceleration is reserved for workloads where transfer overhead is outweighed by computation.

GPU acceleration is reserved for workloads where transfer overhead is outweighed by computation.
records.translation: 真正有帮助的地方。cuML 实现了 spaCR 已经在大表上运行的那些算法：UMAP、t-SNE、PCA、DBSCAN 和 KMeans。这里提供的就是这些。spaCR 所做的其他一切——条形码映射、格式转换、SQLite、报告汇编、分组统计——都是解压缩、文件系统和小表工作，把它们移到 GPU 上只会耗费传输时间而毫无收益。GPU 加速只留给计算量足以抵消传输开销的工作负载。

records.label: spacr.graph_types#2
records.source: IT IS ALSO WHERE EVERY GRAPH IN spaCR GETS ITS STARTING FORM. The DEFAULT GRAPH TYPE setting is stored per data shape (`spacr.qt.preferences`), read back through :func:`chosen_for`, and turned into "what is drawn before the first right-click" by :func:`default_for` and :func:`start_for`. A widget asks one of those two and gets an answer that already accounts for the user's choice, whether that choice fits the data, and whether the data is thick enough to support it -- so the setting reaches a new graph by the graph doing the ordinary thing rather than by remembering to.

records.label: spacr.ops_sample#4
records.source: THE PHENOTYPE PATH IS THE OPPOSITE CASE, which is why the two are separate functions rather than one with a flag. A phenotype channel measured in several cycles IS several samples of one quantity and averaging it is the right thing, and what it emits is the schema ``measure`` already emits. Same plate, same objects, opposite correct answer; a shared flag would make that a caller's choice, and it is not one.

A phenotype channel measured in several cycles IS several samples of one quantity and averaging it is the right thing, and what it emits is the schema ``measure`` already emits. Same laboratory microplate, same objects, opposite correct answer; a shared flag would make that a caller's choice, and it is not one.
records.translation: 表型路径是相反的情况，这就是为什么两者是两个独立的函数，而不是一个带标志的函数。在多个循环中测量的表型通道“就是”同一个量的多个样本，对其取平均是正确的做法，而它输出的正是 ``measure`` 已经输出的模式。同一块板、同样的对象，正确答案却相反；共享标志会让这成为调用者的选择，而它并不是一种选择。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.ResonanceEngine#3
records.source: WHY THE DRIVE IS READ IN :meth:`advance` AND NOT WHERE IT IS USED. Every other engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)``, and two tests hold it down: one shades the same clock on two threads and compares the bytes, another steps one engine twelve times and jumps a second straight to the same clock. Reading a real-time signal inside :meth:`shade` would break both, and it would break them on the SHADING THREAD, where the failure is a picture that differs from the one the GUI thread would have drawn. So the drive is an INPUT, set on the GUI thread between frames under the engine lock exactly as :meth:`set_palette` is, and the promise becomes "a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size, drive)``" -- which is the same promise while nothing is playing, and that is when the tests run.
records.context: WHY THE DRIVE IS READ IN :meth:`advance` AND NOT WHERE IT IS USED. Every other engine promises that a frame is a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size)``, and two tests hold it down: one shades the same clock on two independent execution paths and compares the bytes, another steps one engine twelve times and jumps a second straight to the same clock. Reading a real-time signal inside :meth:`shade` would break both, and it would break them on the SHADING Independent execution path, where the failure is a picture that differs from the one the main GUI execution path would have drawn. So the drive is an INPUT, set on the main GUI execution path between frames under the engine lock exactly as :meth:`set_palette` is, and the promise becomes "a pure function of ``(seed, clock, size, drive)``" -- which is the same promise while nothing is playing, and that is when the tests run.
records.translation: 为什么驱动信号在 :meth:`advance` 中读取，而不是在使用它的地方读取。其他每个引擎都承诺一帧是 ``(seed, clock, size)`` 的纯函数，并有两个测试确保这一点：一个在两个线程上对同一时钟着色并比较字节，另一个将一个引擎推进十二步，并让第二个引擎直接跳到同一时钟。在 :meth:`shade` 内部读取实时信号会破坏这两个测试，而且是在“着色线程”上破坏它们，此时的失败表现为一幅与 GUI 线程本应绘制的画面不同的图像。因此，驱动信号是一个“输入”，在帧与帧之间于 GUI 线程上、在引擎锁的保护下设置，与 :meth:`set_palette` 完全相同，承诺也随之变为“是 ``(seed, clock, size, drive)`` 的纯函数”——在没有播放任何内容时，这与原来的承诺相同，而测试正是在这种情况下运行的。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.loewe_surface#3
records.source: WHY IT CAN BE NaN WHERE BLISS IS NOT: Loewe needs the INVERSE curve -- the dose achieving an observed effect -- and that dose does not exist when the observed effect lies outside a single agent's own plateaus. A combination that kills more than either agent can alone has no Loewe answer, and NaN is the honest one.
records.context: WHY IT CAN BE NaN WHERE BLISS IS NOT: Loewe needs the INVERSE curve -- the dose achieving an observed effect -- and that dose does not exist when the observed effect lies outside a single agent's own plateaus. A combination that kills more than either agent can alone has no Loewe answer, and NaN is the honest one.
records.translation: 为什么它可能是 NaN，而 Bliss 却不是：Loewe 需要“反向”曲线——即达到某一观测效应所需的剂量——而当观测效应超出单个药剂自身的平台区时，这个剂量并不存在。一个杀伤力超过任一药剂单独所能达到的组合没有 Loewe 答案，而 NaN 才是诚实的答案。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.regression_results.read_run_tables#2
records.source: THE PERMUTATION PATH DID NOT ALWAYS DO THAT. It tested genes, corrected them as their own family, wrote them to ``results_gene.csv``, and left ``results.csv`` holding guides alone -- so a reader who asked for genes was shown nothing while the rows sat in a file nothing opened. The writer is fixed, and this reads the older runs too, because a folder on disk does not update itself.

records.translation: 置换路径并不总是这样做。它检验了基因，将其作为独立的一族进行校正，写入 ``results_gene.csv``，而让 ``results.csv`` 只保存引导 RNA——于是请求基因的读者什么也看不到，而这些行却躺在一个没有任何东西会打开的文件里。写入程序已经修复，而这里也会读取旧的运行结果，因为磁盘上的文件夹不会自行更新。
